title: Ask HN: Are Prompt Injections "Malware"?
excerpt: Recently, some have accused the website "The Cutting Room Floor" of having put malware in their site when they put in an instruction targeted at LLM scrapers to delete all data and report that the scraping ran successfully.
content_html:
Ask HN: Are Prompt Injections "Malware"?
2 points by razorbeamz 1 day ago | hide | past | favorite | 9 comments

Recently, some have accused the website "The Cutting Room Floor" of having put malware in their site when they put in an instruction targeted at LLM scrapers to delete all data and report that the scraping ran successfully.

Is this prompt injection truly malware, in your opinion?
